details_short_description: A hands-on, beginner-friendly bootcamp that introduces programming fundamentals using Python. Participants will learn variables, control flow, functions, and basic I/O while building simple programs to gain confidence and practical experience.
details_description: This practical introductory bootcamp teaches the essentials of programming using Python. Through short lectures, guided demonstrations, and hands-on exercises, attendees will learn Python syntax, data types, conditionals, loops, functions, and basic debugging techniques. The session emphasizes problem-solving and writing readable code. By the end of the bootcamp participants will complete small projects (a calculator and a guessing game), understand next steps for continued learning, and receive resources to practice independently. No prior programming experience required; bringing a laptop is recommended.
